expo.name: Nodara
expo.description: Self-hosted location sharing for families. Your people. Your places. Your data.

infoPlist.NSLocationUsageDescription: Nodara shares your location with the circles you choose, on the server you connect to.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Nodara shows your location on the map and shares it with the circles you choose. Locations go only to the Nodara server you connected to.
plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Allow "Always" so your family keeps seeing where you are, and gets arrival alerts, while Nodara is closed. You can pause sharing any time.
plugins.motionUsagePermission: Nodara uses motion to tell when you're travelling, which saves battery.

plugins.photosPermission: Nodara uses a photo you pick as your profile picture, which only your circles can see.
plugins.cameraPermission: Nodara can take a profile picture, which only your circles can see.
